_説明: 金運おきぬの登場人物。絵を作るときに設定画（sheet）を添付して、顔・髪・服を全編でそろえる。make_images_lovart_chars.py が読む
style_en: Soft Japanese hand-drawn anime feature film style: clean gentle line art, hand-painted backgrounds, warm muted colors (cream, ochre, faded indigo, soft brick red), soft window light, subtle film grain. Calm and nostalgic, never glossy or 3D.

sawako.name: 佐和子（001v4は59歳・001v6は66歳・今）
sawako.desc_en: Sawako, a Japanese woman in her sixties: slim and small, kind round face with soft smile lines, shoulder-length dark brown hair with a few grey strands tied loosely at the nape, wears a beige knit cardigan over a white blouse and navy straight trousers.

take.name: タケ（佐和子の祖母・昭和50年ごろ・70代）
take.desc_en: Take, an elderly Japanese woman in her seventies in the 1970s: small and upright, thin face with deep kind wrinkles and narrow calm eyes, grey hair pulled into a neat low bun, wears a plain dark indigo kimono with a white kappogi apron (long-sleeved Japanese housework apron).

sawako_child.name: 佐和子（8歳・昭和50年ごろ）
sawako_child.desc_en: Sawako as an 8-year-old Japanese girl in the 1970s: round face, black bob haircut with straight bangs, wears a red knit cardigan over a white collared blouse and a grey pleated skirt.

masakazu.name: 正和（佐和子の夫・61歳・今）
masakazu.desc_en: Masakazu, a 61-year-old Japanese man: medium build, short neatly cut grey-black hair, rectangular thin-framed glasses, calm gentle face, wears a navy V-neck sweater over a light blue collared shirt and beige chino trousers.

yota.name: 陽太（佐和子の孫・6歳・今）
yota.desc_en: Yota, a 6-year-old Japanese boy: round cheerful face, short black hair with a small cowlick, wears a yellow hooded sweatshirt and dark blue shorts.

okinu.name: おきぬ（語り手・60代前半の金運鑑定師）
okinu.desc_en: Okinu, a Japanese woman in her early sixties: warm round face with gentle smile lines and bright kind eyes, silver-grey hair in a neat low bun held with a simple dark wooden hair stick, wears a muted mustard-gold haori jacket over a cream high-neck blouse and a dark indigo long skirt, small plain gold stud earrings. Calm, friendly, down-to-earth.
okinu.voice_name: 波音リツ（ノーマル）＝語り手

sumie.name: 澄江（001v6・佐和子と同じ団地の友人・66歳・今）
sumie.desc_en: Sumie, a 66-year-old Japanese woman: slightly plump and upright, short softly permed grey hair, round thin silver-rimmed glasses, calm cheerful face with laugh lines, wears a soft olive-green knit cardigan over a light grey blouse and dark brown trousers.

_声: 2026-10-28 から：登場人物のセリフは語り手（VOICEVOX 波音リツ（ノーマル）・9）と違う声で読む（スキル references/16 の3）。台本全体の "voices" に、出る人物の voice を写す。同じ回に出る2人が同じ声にならないようにする（同じ声の人物：別々の回にしか出ない組だけ）。声は仮決め。試聴は characters/_voicetest_2026-10-28/。各キャラの VOICEVOX 規約（収益化・内容の制限）は、初めて公開する前に確かめる
